top_signals.title: Aramco Contains Fire Near Ras Tanura Oil Hub After Attack
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia contained a fire near its biggest oil export terminal at Ras Tanura on the Persian Gulf following an attack in the region, a person with knowledge of the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Morocco Tops South Africa in RMB Continental Investment Ranking
top_signals.summary: Morocco overtook South Africa to become the continent’s fourth-most attractive investment destination as years of industrialization and faster growth propelled it ahead of the region’s biggest economy, FirstRand Ltd.’s Rand Merchant Bank said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
top_signals.summary: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Former pentester used ARTEX AI to steal 8.2 million data records
top_signals.summary: South Korean police identified seven suspects linked to a cybercrime operation that breached more than 90 organizations in the country, with ARTEX AI pentesting framework used in most of the attacks. [...]

top_signals.summary: In an unusual move, the suit — brought under the state’s deceptive trade practices laws — seeks to hold founder and CEO Sam Altman personally liable for the alleged deception.
